name: Debug OCI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop

jobs:
  debug-oci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        gem install bundler
        bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 5

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pnpm run test:tryouts:agent
        pnpm run playwright

    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: pnpm run playwright

    - name: Clean databases
      run: .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb --all
      env:
        REDIS_URL: ${{ secrets.REDIS_URL }}
        VALKEY_URL: ${{ secrets.VALKEY_URL }}

    - name: Check for flash of error/disabled states
